cn: 调查就是解决问题。
en: To investigate is to solve a problem.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《反对本本主义》

cn: 一切结论产生于调查情况的末尾，而不是在它的先头。
en: All conclusions arise at the end of investigation, not at its beginning.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《反对本本主义》

cn: 你对于那个问题不能解决吗？那末，你就去调查那个问题的现状和它的历史吧！
en: If you cannot solve a problem, investigate its present state and its history.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《反对本本主义》

cn: 实践的观点是辩证唯物论的认识论之第一的和基本的观点。
en: The standpoint of practice is the first and fundamental viewpoint of dialectical-materialist epistemology.

cn: 通过实践而发现真理，又通过实践而证实真理和发展真理。
en: Truth is discovered through practice and verified, developed through practice.

cn: 感觉只解决现象问题，理论才解决本质问题。
en: Sense-perception solves questions of appearance; theory solves questions of essence.

cn: 认识从实践始，经过实践得到了理论的认识，还须再回到实践去。
en: Cognition begins with practice; after attaining theoretical understanding through practice, one must return to practice.

cn: 实践、认识、再实践、再认识，这种形式，循环往复以至无穷。
en: Practice, knowledge, again practice, again knowledge — this form is repetitive in endless cycles.

cn: 判定认识或理论之是否真理，不是依主观上觉得如何而定，而是依客观上社会实践的结果如何而定。
en: Whether a cognition or theory is truth depends not on subjective feeling but on the objective result of social practice.

cn: 马克思主义者认为人类的生产活动是最基本的实践活动。
en: Marxists hold that human production activity is the most fundamental practical activity.

cn: 客观现实世界的变化运动永远没有完结，人们在实践中对于真理的认识也就永远没有完结。
en: The objective world changes without end; human cognition of truth through practice has no end either.

cn: 马克思列宁主义并没有结束真理，而是在实践中不断地开辟认识真理的道路。
en: Marxism-Leninism has not ended truth but continually opens up the road to truth through practice.

cn: 事物矛盾的法则，即对立统一的法则，是自然和社会的根本法则，因而也是思维的根本法则。
en: The law of contradiction in things — the law of the unity of opposites — is the fundamental law of nature and society, and therefore of thought.

cn: 没有什么事物是不包含矛盾的，没有矛盾就没有世界。
en: There is nothing that does not contain contradiction; without contradiction there would be no world.

cn: 矛盾是普遍的、绝对的，存在于事物发展的一切过程中，又贯串于一切过程的始终。
en: Contradiction is universal and absolute, present in every process of development and贯穿 through every process from beginning to end.

cn: 矛盾的普遍性和矛盾的特殊性的关系，就是矛盾的共性和个性的关系。
en: The relationship between the universality and particularity of contradiction is the relationship between the general and the individual.

cn: 事物的性质，主要地是由取得支配地位的矛盾的主要方面所规定的。
en: The nature of a thing is mainly determined by the principal aspect of the contradiction that has gained the dominant position.

cn: 唯物辩证法认为外因是变化的条件，内因是变化的根据，外因通过内因而起作用。
en: Materialist dialectics holds that external causes are the conditions of change, internal causes are the basis, and external causes operate through internal causes.

cn: 实事求是。
en: Seek truth from facts.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《改造我们的学习》

cn: “实事”就是客观存在着的一切事物，“是”就是客观事物的内部联系，即规律性，“求”就是我们去研究。
en: 'Shi' means the objective things; 'shi' (is) means their internal relations, i.e., laws; 'qiu' (seek) means we must study them.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《改造我们的学习》

cn: 这种态度，就是实事求是的态度。
en: Such an attitude is that of seeking truth from facts.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《改造我们的学习》

cn: 有的放矢。
en: Aim at the target.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《整顿党的作风》

cn: 马克思主义的“本本”是要学习的，但是必须同我国的实际情况相结合。
en: We must study Marxist 'books,' but they must be combined with China's actual conditions.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《反对本本主义》

cn: 我们要从国内外、省内外、县内外、区内外的实际情况出发，从其中引出其固有的而不是臆造的规律性。
en: We should proceed from the actual conditions within and without the country, province, county, and district, deriving their inherent laws rather than imagined ones.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《改造我们的学习》

cn: 从群众中来，到群众中去。
en: From the masses, to the masses.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《关于领导方法的若干问题》

cn: 群众是真正的英雄，而我们自己则往往是幼稚可笑的。
en: The masses are the real heroes, while we ourselves are often childish and ridiculous.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《〈农村调查〉的序言和跋》

cn: 人民，只有人民，才是创造世界历史的动力。
en: The people, and the people alone, are the motive force in the making of world history.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《论联合政府》

cn: 全心全意地为人民服务，一刻也不脱离群众。
en: Serve the people wholeheartedly, never for a moment divorced from the masses.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《论联合政府》

cn: 我们的共产党和共产党所领导的八路军、新四军，是革命的队伍。我们这个队伍完全是为着解放人民的，是彻底地为人民的利益工作的。
en: Our Party and the armies it leads are revolutionary forces. This force exists entirely for the liberation of the people and works wholly in the people's interests.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《为人民服务》

cn: 为人民利益而死，就比泰山还重。
en: To die for the people is heavier than Mount Tai.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《为人民服务》

cn: 真正的铜墙铁壁是什么？是群众，是千百万真心实意地拥护革命的群众。
en: What is the real wall of bronze and iron? It is the masses — the millions who sincerely support the revolution.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《关心群众生活，注意工作方法》

cn: 依靠民众则一切困难能够克服，任何强敌能够战胜，离开民众则将一事无成。
en: Rely on the people and any difficulty can be overcome, any enemy defeated; without the people, nothing can be accomplished.
source: 《毛泽东军事文集》第二卷《抗战十五个月的总结》

cn: 务必使同志们继续地保持谦虚、谨慎、不骄、不躁的作风。
en: See to it that comrades continue to be modest, prudent, free from arrogance and rashness.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第四卷《在中国共产党第七届中央委员会第二次全体会议上的报告》

cn: 务必使同志们继续地保持艰苦奋斗的作风。
en: See to it that comrades continue to keep the style of hard struggle.

cn: 惩前毖后，治病救人。
en: Learn from past mistakes to avoid future ones, cure the sickness to save the patient.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《整顿党的作风》

cn: 敌进我退，敌驻我扰，敌疲我打，敌退我追。
en: When the enemy advances, we retreat; when he halts, we harass; when he tires, we strike; when he retreats, we pursue.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《星星之火，可以燎原》

cn: 集中优势兵力，各个歼灭敌人。
en: Concentrate superior forces to annihilate the enemy one by one.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第四卷《集中优势兵力，各个歼灭敌人》

cn: 人不犯我，我不犯人；人若犯我，我必犯人。
en: We do not attack unless we are attacked; if attacked, we will certainly counter-attack.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《和中央社、扫荡报、新民报三记者的谈话》

cn: 革命战争是群众的战争，只有动员群众才能进行战争，只有依靠群众才能进行战争。
en: Revolutionary war is a war of the masses; only by mobilizing them can we fight, only by relying on them can we fight.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《关心群众生活，注意工作方法》

cn: 战争的目的不是别的，就是“保存自己，消灭敌人”。
en: The purpose of war is none other than 'preserve oneself and annihilate the enemy.'
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《论持久战》

cn: 保存自己消灭敌人这个战争的目的，就是战争的本质，就是一切战争行动的根据。
en: Preserving oneself and annihilating the enemy — this purpose is the essence of war and the basis of all military action.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《论持久战》

cn: 武器是战争的重要的因素，但不是决定的因素，决定的因素是人不是物。
en: Weapons are an important factor in war but not the decisive one; the decisive factor is people, not things.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《论持久战》

cn: 兵民是胜利之本。
en: Soldiers and civilians are the foundation of victory.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《论持久战》

cn: 战争的伟力之最深厚的根源，存在于民众之中。
en: The deepest source of the great power of war lies in the masses.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《论持久战》

cn: 不打无准备之仗，不打无把握之仗。
en: Fight no battle unprepared, fight no battle without confidence of winning.

cn: 主动性，灵活性，计划性。
en: Initiative, flexibility, planning.

cn: 保存自己消灭敌人的原则，是一切军事原则的根据。
en: The principle of preserving oneself and annihilating the enemy is the basis of all military principles.

cn: 伤其十指不如断其一指。
en: Wounding ten fingers is not as good as severing one.

cn: 要奋斗就会有牺牲，死人的事是经常发生的。
en: Where there is struggle there is sacrifice; death is a common occurrence.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《为人民服务》

cn: 下定决心，不怕牺牲，排除万难，去争取胜利。
en: Resolve decisively, fear no sacrifice, surmount every difficulty to win victory.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《愚公移山》

cn: 我们的同志在困难的时候，要看到成绩，要看到光明，要提高我们的勇气。
en: In times of difficulty our comrades must see the achievements, see the light, and raise their courage.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《为人民服务》

cn: 统一战线，武装斗争，党的建设，是中国共产党在中国革命中战胜敌人的三个法宝。
en: The united front, armed struggle, and Party building are the three magic weapons by which the CCP defeated its enemies in the Chinese revolution.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《〈共产党人〉发刊词》

cn: 发展进步势力，争取中间势力，孤立顽固势力。
en: Develop progressive forces, win over middle forces, isolate die-hard forces.

cn: 我们的文学艺术都是为人民大众的，首先是为工农兵的，为工农兵而创作，为工农兵所利用的。
en: Our literature and art are for the masses of the people, primarily for the workers, peasants, and soldiers — created for them and used by them.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《在延安文艺座谈会上的讲话》

cn: 文艺作品中反映出来的生活却可以而且应该比普通的实际生活更高，更强烈，更有集中性，更典型，更理想，因此就更带普遍性。
en: The life reflected in literary works can and should be higher, more intense, more concentrated, more typical, more ideal, and thus more universal than ordinary life.

cn: 在现在世界上，一切文化或文学艺术都是属于一定的阶级，属于一定的政治路线的。
en: In today's world, all culture, literature, and art belong to a definite class and political line.

cn: 我们的文艺工作者一定要完成这个任务，一定要把立足点移过来。
en: Our literary and art workers must accomplish this task and must shift their standpoint.

cn: 百花齐放，百家争鸣。
en: Let a hundred flowers bloom, a hundred schools of thought contend.

cn: 推陈出新。
en: Discard the old and bring forth the new.

cn: 学习我们的历史遗产，用马克思主义的方法给以批判的总结。
en: Study our historical heritage and give it a critical summation with Marxist methods.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《中国共产党在民族战争中的地位》

cn: 清理古代文化的发展过程，剔除其封建性的糟粕，吸收其民主性的精华，是发展民族新文化提高民族自信心的必要条件。
en: Sorting through ancient cultural development, removing its feudal dross and absorbing its democratic essence is necessary for developing new national culture.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《新民主主义论》

cn: 发展生产，保障供给。
en: Develop production, ensure supply.

cn: 贪污和浪费是极大的犯罪。
en: Corruption and waste are the greatest crimes.

cn: 我们的方针要放在什么基点上？放在自己力量的基点上，叫做自力更生。
en: On what basis should our policy rest? On our own strength — that is called self-reliance.

cn: 要使全体干部和全体人民经常想到我国是一个社会主义的大国，但又是一个经济落后的穷国。
en: All our cadres and people should constantly remember that we are a great socialist country but still an economically backward poor one.

cn: 学习的敌人是自己的满足，要认真学习一点东西，必须从不自满开始。
en: Self-satisfaction is the enemy of study. To study seriously one must start by casting away self-satisfaction.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第二卷《中国共产党在民族战争中的地位》

cn: 情况是在不断地变化，要使自己的思想适应新的情况，就得学习。
en: Conditions change constantly; to keep one's thinking in step with new conditions, one must study.
source: 《毛泽东文集》第七卷《在中国共产党全国宣传工作会议上的讲话》

cn: 读书是学习，使用也是学习，而且是更重要的学习。
en: Reading is learning; using is also learning — and a more important kind.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《中国革命战争的战略问题》

cn: 重要的问题在善于学习。
en: The important thing is to be good at learning.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第一卷《中国革命战争的战略问题》

cn: 我们能够学会我们原来不懂的东西。
en: We can master what we did not understand before.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第四卷《在中国共产党第七届中央委员会第二次全体会议上的报告》

cn: 对于马克思主义的理论，要能够精通它、应用它，精通的目的全在于应用。
en: With regard to Marxist theory, one must master and apply it; mastery serves only application.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第三卷《整顿党的作风》

cn: 人是要有一点精神的。
en: People must have some spirit.
source: 《毛泽东文集》第七卷《艰苦奋斗是我们的政治本色》

cn: 世界观的转变是一个根本的转变。
en: A change in world outlook is a fundamental change.

cn: 中国应当对于人类有较大的贡献。
en: China should make greater contributions to humanity.
source: 《毛泽东选集》第五卷《纪念孙中山先生》

cn: 一切反动派都是纸老虎。
en: All reactionaries are paper tigers.

cn: 恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒。
en: We were young, in our prime; students full of spirit, gesturing boldly.

cn: 指点江山，激扬文字，粪土当年万户侯。
en: Pointing to river and mountain, with stirring words we counted the old lords of ten thousand households as nothing.

cn: 问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮？
en: I ask the vast earth: who rules its rise and fall?

cn: 红军不怕远征难，万水千山只等闲。
en: The Red Army fears not the trials of distant march, nor the myriad mountains and rivers.

cn: 五岭逶迤腾细浪，乌蒙磅礴走泥丸。
en: The Five Ridges wind like small waves; the Wumeng mountains roll like mud balls.

cn: 更喜岷山千里雪，三军过后尽开颜。
en: More delightful still, the thousand-mile snow of Min Mountains; after the three armies cross, all faces light up.

cn: 北国风光，千里冰封，万里雪飘。
en: Northern scenery: a thousand leagues locked in ice, ten thousand leagues of whirling snow.

cn: 望长城内外，惟余莽莽；大河上下，顿失滔滔。
en: Within and without the Great Wall, all is boundless white; up and down the Yellow River, the roaring torrents vanish.

cn: 山舞银蛇，原驰蜡象，欲与天公试比高。
en: Mountains dance like silver serpents; highlands race like wax elephants, all wishing to vie with the sky.

cn: 须晴日，看红装素裹，分外妖娆。
en: On a clear day, in crimson dress and white wrap, she looks all the more enchanting.

cn: 江山如此多娇，引无数英雄竞折腰。
en: So fair are these rivers and mountains, they have drawn countless heroes to bow in homage.

cn: 惜秦皇汉武，略输文采；唐宗宋祖，稍逊风骚。
en: Alas, Qin Huang and Han Wu were wanting in literary grace; Tang Zong and Song Zu somewhat lacking in poetic charm.

cn: 俱往矣，数风流人物，还看今朝。
en: All are gone; for true heroes, look to this age alone.

cn: 雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越。
en: The mighty pass is like iron, yet we stride from the beginning, starting anew.

cn: 天若有情天亦老，人间正道是沧桑。
en: Were heaven to feel, it too would grow old; the righteous path of man is through vicissitudes.

cn: 钟山风雨起苍黄，百万雄师过大江。
en: Storm winds rise over Purple Mountain, the sky turns grey; a million mighty troops cross the great river.

cn: 虎踞龙盘今胜昔，天翻地覆慨而慷。
en: Where tigers crouched and dragons coiled is better than of old; heaven and earth turned upside down, both stirring and generous.

cn: 宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王。
en: Use the leftover courage to pursue the beaten foe; do not, like a would-be king, seek a hollow name.

cn: 牢骚太盛防肠断，风物长宜放眼量。
en: Too much complaint will break your heart; view the world with broader eyes.

cn: 一万年太久，只争朝夕。
en: Ten thousand years are too long; seize the day, seize the hour.

cn: 为有牺牲多壮志，敢教日月换新天。
en: Because of many sacrifices, great ambitions arise; daring to make the sun and moon shine anew.

cn: 春风杨柳万千条，六亿神州尽舜尧。
en: Spring wind blows ten thousand willows; six hundred million in divine land, all sage-kings.

cn: 红雨随心翻作浪，青山着意化为桥。
en: Red rain follows our heart and becomes waves; green mountains turn into bridges at our will.
